# Tab cell-run golden fixture
# Unicode 15.0.0 — tab expansion (positional)
#
# Tab (U+0009) advances to the next column index that is a multiple of
# tab_width, measured from the logical line start (column 0).
# Minimum advance: 1 column (when already on a tab stop).
#
# Format: description | utf8 bytes (hex) | tab_width → total_cells | spans
# Kind codes: T=text, C=combining, TAB=tab, CTL=control, INV=invalid_utf8

# Tab at column 0, tab_width=4 → advance to column 4 (4 cells)
tab_col0_w4       | 09             | 4 → 4 | 0:1:4:TAB

# Tab at column 0, tab_width=8 → advance to column 8 (8 cells)
tab_col0_w8       | 09             | 8 → 8 | 0:1:8:TAB

# Tab at column 0, tab_width=1 → advance to column 1 (1 cell)
tab_col0_w1       | 09             | 1 → 1 | 0:1:1:TAB

# "ab\t" at tab_width=4:
#   'a' at col 0 → col 1, 'b' at col 1 → col 2, '\t' at col 2 → next multiple of 4 = col 4 (2 cells)
# Total: 1 + 1 + 2 = 4 cells
ab_tab_w4         | 61 62 09       | 4 → 4 | 0:1:1:T 1:1:1:T 2:1:2:TAB

# "abcd\t" at tab_width=4:
#   'd' lands on col 3, '\t' at col 4 (already on tab stop) → advance 4 cells to col 8
# Total: 4 + 4 = 8 cells
abcd_tab_w4       | 61 62 63 64 09 | 4 → 8 | 0:1:1:T 1:1:1:T 2:1:1:T 3:1:1:T 4:1:4:TAB

# "a\tb" at tab_width=4:
#   'a' at col 0 → col 1, '\t' at col 1 → advance 3 cells to col 4, 'b' at col 4 → col 5
# Total: 1 + 3 + 1 = 5 cells
a_tab_b_w4        | 61 09 62       | 4 → 5 | 0:1:1:T 1:1:3:TAB 2:1:1:T

# Two consecutive tabs at tab_width=4 from column 0:
#   first tab: col 0 → col 4 (4 cells); second tab: col 4 → col 8 (4 cells)
# Total: 8 cells
two_tabs_w4       | 09 09          | 4 → 8 | 0:1:4:TAB 1:1:4:TAB

# Tab at column 0, tab_width=2
tab_col0_w2       | 09             | 2 → 2 | 0:1:2:TAB
